params.name: organizationId
params.description:
The unique identifier of the target [organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).

items.docs:
Gets a specific context mapping by key.

**Required privilege:** Merchandising Hub - View

Privilege required ``` {"owner":"COMMERCE","targetDomain":"MERCHANDISING_HUB","type":"VIEW","targetId":"*"} ```
